source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of recognizing threats (PDF 189).

blocks.text: Khatre pehchanein jaise phishing scams, bharosemand idara ban kar hassas maloomat nikalwane ki koshishein (zaati tafseel maangne wali fori emails se hoshiyar rahein), aur malware, nuqsan deh software jo computer kharab ya data chori karta hai (ghair bharosemand downloads se bachein aur antivirus update rakhein).

blocks.prompt: Malware kya hai, aur is ka khatra kaise kam karein?
blocks.explanation: Nuqsan deh software jo aalaat kharab ya data chori karta hai; sirf bharosemand maakhaz se download karein aur antivirus update rakhein.

items: Khatre pehchanein: phishing scams aur malware.
